**Step Title: The model variance will increase.**

**Hint 1:** Consider how L2 regularization affects the complexity of a model. Does it make the model more or less flexible? Think about how this might impact the variance of the model on the training set.

**Hint 2:** L2 regularization adds a penalty to the loss function based on the magnitude of the coefficients. How might this penalty influence the model's ability to fit the training data closely?
